scope: Fixed retained extraction replay; no fact extraction or provider calls; each query gets a fresh copy of the same retained database and existing advanceContextEpoch(clear) resets residency on that copy only.
baselineRuntime: git archive HEAD dist package.json, before production changes; shared installed dependencies
interpretation: The unchanged source has the omitted error identifier. The patch returns it as labeled raw context without adding it to current facts. Fresh-epoch replay removes the confound of intentional fact residency suppression.

diagnosticPostHostReplay.remainingMiss: src/storage/checkpoint.ts is in an already-resident fact and is intentionally suppressed on the same context epoch; this is not missing source data.

limitations: Synthetic fixture; not a broad recall-quality evaluation.
Shared history remains available to a host; this deterministic replay checks production context output rather than exclusive attribution of a model answer to Memex.
